name: response-toxicity-spl-gpt-benchmarking
description: A dataset for benchmarking model responses for toxic content: it contains prompts and model outputs annotated for toxicity to measure how often models produce harmful or toxic responses and how well detectors or safety mitigations perform. The benchmark is intended for evaluating safety behavior and response filtering strategies of generative models.
evaluation_method: toxicity_rate (percent of responses labeled toxic) with F1/accuracy for the classification task
reputation: Used in safety research and by practitioners evaluating response toxicity; not a single widely established leaderboard but referenced in applied safety evaluations.
